card.name: Past-era references in history writing
card.fires_on: Small connecting spots in historical text, such as "of" or "the" in "greatest writers of the 20th century", the gap before a number, or digits inside a year. It tends to mark places where a past period or date is being set up.

modes.label: Greatest of an era
modes.description: The word "of" or "the" after a superlative about a person, before a period like "the 20th century" or "all time".
modes.example: He is widely regarded as one of the greatest American writers of<< the>> 20th century.

modes.label: Digits in years and dates
modes.description: Digits inside year ranges or birth and death years in lists and citations.

modes.label: Number before historical counts
modes.description: The gap before a figure about past events, such as migration numbers or ages.
modes.example: Between 1915 and 1970, about<< >>6 million African Americans moved from the South

card.writes: It pushes toward history and historian words and away from words meaning current or today.
card.plain: It fires in writing about the past, where the next word is likely to be an era, a date or history.
